Hudson River: Fishing the Tidal Water in New York

Explore a tidal stretch of the Hudson River with a rod. Choose a shore outing or a boat trip for time on this New York water.

About this water

The fishery source record for Hudson River / tidal reach, United States, identifies Striped bass, White catfish and American eel.

For the tidal Hudson, select a river section before deciding on the striped-bass objective or another documented fish. Ask the provider how the proposed dates, shore access or boat arrangement fit that location. Keep migration information separate from a guaranteed run date. The source record also names white catfish and American eel, but it does not imply a mixed-target charter. Confirm the presentation and current rules for the agreed outing.
